description: The main posture: fully autonomous on GPT-6-Astra, no sandbox, no approvals, no subagents. `approval_policy = "never"` plus `sandbox_mode = "danger-full-access"` is exactly what `--yolo` sets, verified by comparing session headers; `--full-auto` was removed in 0.155.1 and `--skip-permissions` never existed in this product. Reasoning is `max` rather than `ultra` because the catalog defines `ultra` as maximum reasoning *with automatic task delegation*, which contradicts running without subagents. Context is opened to this account's real ceiling of 872000 (95% usable = 828400) with compaction at 800000; the often-quoted 1M window is the API model's, not this build's. `multi_agent` ships enabled and is turned off here -- disabling `multi_agent_v2` alone is not enough.
